title: Data Ingestion Script Compiler
description: Compiles raw data ingestion scripts. Enforces raw data immutability, idempotent loading, pathlib paths, structured logging, schema validation at boundary, and proper main guards.

error_codes.DI002: Hardcoded absolute path — use pathlib.Path and config/env vars
error_codes.DI004: print() used instead of logging — use logging.getLogger(__name__)
error_codes.DI005: Raw data directory written or overwritten — raw data is immutable
error_codes.DI006: Script is not idempotent — re-running produces different output files
error_codes.DI007: Data not validated against schema at load boundary
